first_smoke.purpose: Engineering smoke and initial archival web, not a scientific discovery claim.

graph.independence_rule: Same-source retellings do not increase independence_count.
graph.promotion_rule: Graph density or semantic similarity alone can never promote a claim.

CIA.note: Seeded by exact declassified Reading Room identifiers; provider interface is extensible.

NARA.note: Uses NARA official bulk-download metadata links rather than the keyed Catalog API for mirroring; large ZIP/PDF bytes stay as source pointers unless explicitly fetched.

purpose: Ingest official public archival metadata/text into append-only JSON rails and weave low-confidence discovery graphs that can strengthen only through explicit provenance or independent evidence.

storage_contract.git_raw_unexamined: Small JSON/JSONL metadata, extracted public text, hashes, manifests, graph receipts.
storage_contract.large_binaries: Do not mirror automatically into GitHub; preserve official URL, size/hash when fetched, and provenance pointer.
